crossRefs.note: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak…
but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends…

translations.web: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
